feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Coal no longer king in Navajo Nation presidential election
entry.summary: For the first time in decades, there's no pro-coal candidate for Navajo Nation president. Coal has been an important part of the economy, but voter sentiment is changing.

entry.title: Trump offered a closing message to voters by touting his D.C. renovations
entry.summary: In Washington, President Trump delivered his last expected public address, pushing a weaving message to the public about why they should support Republicans.

entry.title: AI chatbots are becoming political advisers. Their answers can mislead voters
entry.summary: Millions of Americans are turning to AI for election information, but chatbots are getting voting facts wrong and recommending candidates, raising concerns they could influence voters' decisions.

entry.title: Is America really that polarized? The answer might be a surprise
entry.summary: The U.S. has become more politically polarized, but research shows people overestimate their differences and there is 'messy middle' majority of Americans who share overlapping political views.

entry.title: Judge accuses DOJ of 'weaponization,' tosses case against ex-FBI officials
entry.summary: The judge said he was "deeply troubled" by the mistakes and rushed nature of the case over the FBI's Hunter Biden probes — one of several politically charged DOJ actions ahead of the midterms.

entry.title: The Supreme Court rejects a DOJ push to separate California ballots
entry.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court has denied a last-minute request from the Department of Justice to wade into its unprecedented feud with California over the state's voter rolls.

entry.title: Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran
entry.summary: Democrats in Michigan are considering their options after Haley Stevens endorsed GOP candidate Mike Rogers for Senate. And the Gulf states are bracing for a possible U.S. attack on Iran after the midterms.

entry.title: Two economists studied California's billionaire tax. They reached wildly different conclusions
entry.summary: What happens in California could shape how America taxes the superrich. But will its billionaire tax fill state coffers — or drain them?

entry.title: When it comes to election pressure, this year's Georgia or Michigan could be anywhere
entry.summary: The districts that will decide control of the House and Senate next year are spread across the country. Voting officials in those places may face scrutiny and pressure they've never experienced.

entry.title: 6 things to watch for on election night
entry.summary: Some of the key storylines to watch will center around various voters groups that have soured on President Trump during his second turn out.
